construction: Manually written surface-form perturbations of the six positive unit-smoke cases. They preserve the intended phenotype-level target but are not independent clinical gold.

cases.text: Blood gas showed acidemia at pH 7.12; HCO3 was depleted to 9 mmol/L, and the calculated gap had widened to 28.
The red-cell count was falling. The smear contained fragmented erythrocytes, haptoglobin was absent, and both LDH and unconjugated bilirubin had risen.
Urinary protein loss reached 6.0 g per 24 hours, circulating albumin was depleted to 2.0 g/dL, and the patient developed anasarca.
Alk phos was 775 U/L (upper limit 120), alanine aminotransferase 45 U/L (upper limit 40), and gamma GT 553 U/L (upper limit 60).
At both lung bases, peripheral honeycomb cysts accompanied bronchi pulled open by traction from the surrounding fibrosis.
While breathing ambient air, arterial oxygen tension measured 58 mmHg with a technically sound sample.
